name: Pierre Paillot
signature: AI builds fast. I build right.

meta.title: Pierre Paillot · I turn a problem into an AI tool that runs
meta.description: AI consultant and builder. I design, build and ship AI tools for companies, from audit to production, until your teams actually use them. Not a slide. A product.

hero.title: I turn a business problem into a product your teams actually use.
hero.subtitle: From audit to production, with nothing left gathering dust.
hero.ambition: I'm not looking for a developer job. I'm looking for hard problems, and I build the products that solve them.

lines: A consultant stops at the diagnosis.
phrase.punch: I do all three: I diagnose, I build, I drive adoption.

scope.title: I don't build one product. I build dozens.
scope.why: I'm not chasing the perfect project. I'd rather build ten products, learn ten times, and keep the ones that truly create value.
scope.note: By directing AI with real engineering standards. Up to 5,000 visits per month in organic SEO.

offer.title: On a mission or in-house, I take a vague need and turn it into a concrete product.

items.label: Understand
items.text: I pinpoint the real business problem.

items.label: Build
items.text: I ship a product in production.

items.label: Drive adoption
items.text: I make sure it gets used.

offer.footer: On a mission or full-time, I embed with your team and I ship. It runs when I leave, or I stay for what's next.

atelier.title: I don't ask you to trust me. I show you.
atelier.subtitle: Products I designed and put online. Click, they're alive.

proof.title: The field, not just the screen.
proof.lead: Before building, I spent five years inside companies, between leadership and teams. I learned there what no technology teaches: how to spot a real problem, and how to make a solution actually get used.

items.label: Founder
items.text: I built my own company, from incorporation to the first quote, alone.

items.label: Goalmap
items.text: Transformation and change management consultant for 500+ organizations.

quote.text: Pierre is a rare profile, the kind you miss. Committed, professional and deeply human. He fit into the team fast, took on challenges with enthusiasm, delivered his work with success and set the bar high. We wish he had stayed.
quote.author: Paul Munos

soul.text: I've spent fifteen years trying to understand one thing: why people do what they do. Sociology, coaching, three books. It doesn't make me a better coder. It makes me someone who builds tools people actually want to use. And that, no AI does for me.

contactSection.title: Got a problem in mind? Let's talk.
contactSection.text: Describe your need in two lines. I'll tell you honestly whether I'm the right person, and how I'd approach it.
